sources.entry: MoMo Agent - Open-source, self-hosted 24/7 personal agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac with on-device CoreML ASR, embedded Tailscale, and an Obsidian-style Markdown memory vault. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: MoMo Agent is an open-source, self-hosted personal agent for Apple Watch, iPhone, and Mac that records speech, transcribes it on-device, and builds a self-organizing Markdown memory vault.
summary.what_it_does: MoMo Agent is a self-hosted system with an Apple Watch and iPhone app for hands-free capture (including Bluetooth earphones), and a Mac app that acts as the hub. Speech is transcribed on the iPhone using on-device neural models, with speaker recognition via voiceprints. The Mac hub distills conversations into a multi-level Obsidian-style Markdown vault with backlinks and audio proof, and can create Apple Reminders, Calendar events, and Notes from spoken commitments. It also produces a Morning Briefing and illustrated daily journal with a footprint map. The agent runs on a subscription the user already has (Codex, Claude, Antigravity, or a custom OpenAI-compatible API), and devices connect through a built-in Tailscale mesh or local Wi-Fi. The README describes build steps with Xcode and xcodegen, and a prebuilt Mac zip is available from Releases.
use_cases: record and transcribe my day from an Apple Watch
keep a searchable Markdown memory of conversations
turn spoken to-dos into Apple Reminders
generate a daily morning briefing from my notes
illustrated life journal with a location map
self-host a personal assistant on my own Mac
how_to_run: git clone https://github.com/Miri-Labs/MoMo-Agent (clone URL missing from README; use repository page)
cp Config/Local.xcconfig.example Config/Local.xcconfig, then set MOMO_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM and MOMO_BUNDLE_ID_PREFIX
notable: Transcription runs locally on the iPhone at $0 per use, with no third-party cloud for audio
Built-in Tailscale mesh to reach the home Mac without port forwarding
Voiceprint enrollment so only the owner's spoken commitments become tasks
Obsidian-style multi-level Markdown vault with bidirectional links and audio-backed memories
Supports switching between Codex, Claude, Antigravity, or a custom API in one click
caveats: Requires Apple platforms: Mac on macOS 15.0+, iPhone on iOS 17.0+, Apple Watch on watchOS 10.0+, and Xcode 16+ to build
Needs an Apple Developer Team ID for signing and an existing AI subscription or custom API
AirPods seamless route switching and two-way external vault sync are listed as unfinished roadmap items
Code is AGPL-3.0-only; third-party components and model weights have their own licenses, and README device illustrations are noncommercial only
